processes.name: Invoice Processing
processes.description: Invoice arrives by email; finance reads fields, checks duplicate, enters ERP, routes approval, updates status.

processes.name: Employee Onboarding
processes.description: HR receives starter information, creates tasks for IT/admin, follows up, and confirms completion.

processes.name: Monthly Management Reporting
processes.description: Analyst exports data, cleans and reconciles figures, prepares dashboard/slides, sends report.

processes.name: Purchase Request
processes.description: Requester submits need, manager approves, procurement compares quotations, creates PO and notifies requester.

processes.name: Customer Complaint Triage
processes.description: Email arrives, agent categorizes issue, checks customer context, routes to responsible team and tracks SLA.
